title: Blue Pine
body:
Description

Blue Pine trees can be found on the central hill of Finlay Island. They appear as blue tinted trees with many branches that come to a point near the top of the main log. The sanded version of this wood has a bright pale blue color.

The Blue Pine is a tree native to the central hilly region of Finlay Island where the grass grows a more blue-green color compared to the spawn region's more vibrantly green-colored grass. The Blue Pine is identified by its blue-gray bark and blue-green leaves, a color similar to that of the grass where it grows. Similar to the Spruce, the Blue Pine takes on a tall, thin, and slender shape and stands about 45 studs tall, making it slightly taller than the Spruce on average. It is a heavy tree and cannot be picked up off the ground by the end of its trunk with a player's hand unless with the Grabby Grabber or Grabbiest Grabber, or the player picks it up on its side near the middle.

As with any other material in the game, logged, sanded, and planked Spruce can be used to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • It has the most branches out of all trees in the game.
  • The leaves bear somewhat of a resemblance to Magma and Snow trees.
